caribbean.headline: Nassau Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Nassau is experiencing 18 kt winds, 1.9 ft waves, a dominant SE swell period of 5 s, and 100% rain probability, and I note these conditions. I also observe Martinique, the runner-up, with 12 kt winds and no significant swell.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Sees Moderate Winds, Light Rain
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille is experiencing 15 kt winds and 3.6 ft waves, with 38% rain probability. Haifa reports 17 kt winds, while the rest of the Mediterranean remains calm.
